props.description: Handler that is called when the element loses focus.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Handler that is called when a key is pressed.

props.name: onKeyUp
props.description: Handler that is called when a key is released.

props.name: onClick
props.description:
**Not recommended – use `onPress` instead.** `onClick` is an alias for `onPress`
provided for compatibility with other libraries. `onPress` provides
additional event details for non-mouse interactions.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the button is disabled.

props.name: value
props.description: The value associated with the button's name when it's submitted with the form data.

props.name: formAction
props.description:
The URL that processes the information submitted by the button.
Overrides the action attribute of the button's form owner.

props.name: formEncType
props.description: Indicates how to encode the form data that is submitted.

props.name: formMethod
props.description: Indicates the HTTP method used to submit the form.

props.name: formNoValidate
props.description: Indicates that the form is not to be validated when it is submitted.

props.name: formTarget
props.description: Overrides the target attribute of the button's form owner.

props.name: name
props.description: Submitted as a pair with the button's value as part of the form data.

props.name: type
props.description: The behavior of the button when used in an HTML form.

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Handler that is called when the element's focus status changes.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Handler that is called when the press is released over the target.

props.name: onPressStart
props.description: Handler that is called when a press interaction starts.

props.name: onPressEnd
props.description:
Handler that is called when a press interaction ends, either
over the target or when the pointer leaves the target.

props.name: onPressChange
props.description: Handler that is called when the press state changes.

props.name: onPressUp
props.description:
Handler that is called when a press is released over the target, regardless of
whether it started on the target or not.

props.name: excludeFromTabOrder
props.description:
Whether to exclude the element from the sequential tab order. If true,
the element will not be focusable via the keyboard by tabbing. This should
be avoided except in rare scenarios where an alternative means of accessing
the element or its functionality via the keyboard is available.

props.name: preventFocusOnPress
props.description:
Whether to prevent focus from moving to the button when pressing it.

Caution, this can make the button inaccessible and should only be used when alternative
keyboard interaction is provided, such as ComboBox's MenuTrigger or a NumberField's
increment/decrement control.

props.name: onHoverStart
props.description: Handler that is called when a hover interaction starts.

props.name: onHoverEnd
props.description: Handler that is called when a hover interaction ends.

props.name: onHoverChange
props.description: Handler that is called when the hover state changes.

props.name: slot
props.description:
A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.

props.name: children
props.description:
The children of the component. A function may be provided to alter the children based on
component state.

props.name: style
props.description:
The inline [style](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/style) for the
element. A function may be provided to compute the style based on component state.

props.name: render
props.description:
Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
This allows rendering existing components with built-in styles and behaviors
such as router links, animation libraries, and pre-styled components.

Requirements:

- You must render the expected element type (e.g. if `<button>` is expected, you cannot render an
  `<a>`).
- Only a single root DOM element can be rendered (no fragments).
- You must pass through props and ref to the underlying DOM element, merging with your own prop
  as appropriate.

props.name: suppressHydrationWarning
props.description:
A React-only flag that suppresses the warning React normally logs when an element's
server-rendered content doesn't match the client render during hydration. See [React
docs](https://react.dev/reference/react-dom/client/hydrateRoot#suppressing-unavoidable-hydration-mismatch-errors).

props.name: className
props.description:
The CSS [className](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/className) for the
element. A function may be provided to compute the class based on component state.

props.name: trigger
props.description:
The name of the component that triggered the popover. This is reflected on the element
as the `data-trigger` attribute, and can be used to provide specific
styles for the popover depending on which element triggered it.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description:
The ref for the element which the popover positions itself with respect to.

When used within a trigger component such as DialogTrigger, MenuTrigger, Select, etc.,
this is set automatically. It is only required when used standalone.

props.name: isEntering
props.description: Whether the popover is currently performing an entry animation.

props.name: isExiting
props.description: Whether the popover is currently performing an exit animation.

props.name: shouldSkipAnimation
props.description:
Whether the popover should appear and disappear without an entry or exit animation. This is
used by components such as PreviewTrigger to skip animations when quickly swapping between
overlays.

props.name: UNSTABLE_portalContainer
props.description:
The container element in which the overlay portal will be placed. This may have unknown
behavior depending on where it is portalled to.

props.name: offset
props.description:
The additional offset applied along the main axis between the element and its
anchor element.

props.name: placement
props.description: The placement of the element with respect to its anchor element.

props.name: containerPadding
props.description:
The placement padding that should be applied between the element and its
surrounding container.

props.name: crossOffset
props.description:
The additional offset applied along the cross axis between the element and its
anchor element.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description:
Whether the element should flip its orientation (e.g. top to bottom or left to right) when
there is insufficient room for it to render completely.

props.name: boundaryElement
props.description: Element that that serves as the positioning boundary.

props.name: arrowRef
props.description: A ref for the popover arrow element.

props.name: scrollRef
props.description: A ref for the scrollable region within the overlay.

props.name: shouldUpdatePosition
props.description: Whether the overlay should update its position automatically.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description:
The maxHeight specified for the overlay element.
By default, it will take all space up to the current viewport height.

props.name: arrowBoundaryOffset
props.description: The minimum distance the arrow's edge should be from the edge of the overlay element.

props.name: getTargetRect
props.description:
Overrides the target element's bounding rectangle. Useful for positioning relative to
a specific point such as the mouse cursor (e.g. context menus) or text selection.

props.name: onFocusWithin
props.description: Handler that is called when the target element or a descendant receives focus.

props.name: onBlurWithin
props.description: Handler that is called when the target element and all descendants lose focus.

props.name: onFocusWithinChange
props.description: Handler that is called when the the focus within state changes.

props.name: isNonModal
props.description:
Whether the popover is non-modal, i.e. elements outside the popover may be
interacted with by assistive technologies.

Most popovers should not use this option as it may negatively impact the screen
reader experience. Only use with components such as combobox, which are designed
to handle this situation carefully.

props.name: isKeyboardDismissDisabled
props.description:
Whether pressing the escape key to close the popover should be disabled.

Most popovers should not use this option. When set to true, an alternative
way to close the popover with a keyboard must be provided.

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description:
When user interacts with the argument element outside of the popover ref,
return true if onClose should be called. This gives you a chance to filter
out interaction with elements that should not dismiss the popover.
By default, onClose will always be called on interaction outside the popover ref.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the overlay is open by default (controlled).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the overlay is open by default (uncontrolled).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Handler that is called when the overlay's open state changes.

props.name: children
props.description:
The children of the component. A function may be provided to alter the children based on
component state.

props.name: style
props.description:
The inline [style](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/style) for the
element. A function may be provided to compute the style based on component state.

props.name: render
props.description:
Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
This allows rendering existing components with built-in styles and behaviors
such as router links, animation libraries, and pre-styled components.

Requirements:

- You must render the expected element type (e.g. if `<button>` is expected, you cannot render an
  `<a>`).
- Only a single root DOM element can be rendered (no fragments).
- You must pass through props and ref to the underlying DOM element, merging with your own prop
  as appropriate.

props.name: slot
props.description:
A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

props.name: aria-details
props.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the
object.

props.name: suppressHydrationWarning
props.description:
A React-only flag that suppresses the warning React normally logs when an element's
server-rendered content doesn't match the client render during hydration. See [React
docs](https://react.dev/reference/react-dom/client/hydrateRoot#suppressing-unavoidable-hydration-mismatch-errors).
